_meta.description: Kiosk-mode safety model for DCFG DevOps monitoring agent. Default read-only, explicit approval per write, auto-fallback.

operatingMode.description: Agent monitors all systems and writes ONLY to its own operational tables. Any write to business/portal data requires explicit operator approval.

allowed: Write to agent-owned tables (dcfg_brain_insights, dcfg_agent_audit_log, dcfg_agent_session_trace, dcfg_agent_diagnostic)
blocked: Write to any dcfg_ business table

activation.description: Operator must type 'y' or 'yes' (case-insensitive) in response to a specific write request. No other input activates write mode.
activation.promptFormat:
WRITE REQUEST: {description of what will be changed}
Type 'y' to approve this single operation, or anything else to skip.
activation.notes: The prompt must state exactly what will be written, to which table, in which environment. No vague approvals.

readWriteScope.description: Write mode activates for exactly ONE operation, then immediately returns to READ_ONLY. No batching, no session-based approval.

autoFallback.trigger: After every write operation completes (success or failure)
autoFallback.description: Write mode never persists. Each write is a one-shot approval. If the operator walks away mid-prompt, the system stays read-only because no 'y' was received.

agentOwnedTables.description: Tables the agent can write to without approval — these are its operational data, not business data.

auditOfAudits.description: Every write operation (approved or denied) is logged to dcfg_agent_audit_log.
